description.value: John Ward Fine Coffee is a modern, light-filled café on a prominent corner of Baker Street in the heart of downtown Nelson, with seating for up to 40 guests and large windows offering a front-row view of one of BC's most vibrant small-city streets. The café sources its beans from Origins Coffee Roasters, a Vancouver-based artisan roaster with over 35 years of experience and a commitment to sustainable, farmer-friendly practices. Touring cyclists passing through Nelson will find a welcoming gathering place that has established itself as a community anchor for locals and visitors alike.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at johnwardfinecoffee.com confirms the business is a café at 503 Baker St, Nelson, BC, corroborating the OSM location data. A name discrepancy is present: OSM records 'John Ward Cafe' while the website consistently and prominently uses 'John Ward Fine Coffee.'
